references.context: Subspace of X×X consisting of pairs (x_1,x_2) with equal f-images, carrying the pullback/subspace topology
Map x↦(x,x), well-defined since both projections to Y equal f(x)
Diagonal subset is closed in the pullback topological space, not merely closed in X×X unless additional target assumptions hold

references.disposition: This is a topological map property and is not identified with closed-immersion of a scheme diagonal.

review_rationale: Read the topological separated-map criterion through its diagonal into a fibre product of spaces, with a closed image requirement. Avoided conflating this with separated morphisms of schemes or with Hausdorffness of every topology.
